Hymn 313: God Is Love
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Robert Cundick

This is hymn number 313 titled "God Is Love" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Robert Cundick and the lyrics were written by Philip Bliss.
